question: Will the 12-month change in the U.S. core PCE price index, excluding food and energy (BEA, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for April 2026 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2026-04-15) be at least 2.50% and below 3.00%?

rule.threshold_basis: rounded lower and upper quartiles of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
